ref_text: BUT IN TRUTH PEARL WAS THE ONE AS WELL AS THE OTHER AND ONLY IN CONSEQUENCE OF THAT IDENTITY HAD HESTER CONTRIVED SO PERFECTLY TO REPRESENT THE SCARLET LETTER IN HER APPEARANCE
text: But in truth, Pearl was the one as well as the other, and only in consequence of that identity had hestered, contrived so perfectly to represent the scarlet letter in her appearance.
